lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line is a truncated dash near the shoulder. The fourth line is significantly thinner and shorter than its neighbors. The final posterior line is a shortened segment near the base of the tail.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A grouping of 5-6 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch and upper hind limb area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the mid-thigh align horizontally, while three spots on the lower haunch form a loose diagonal cluster.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white patch on the lower throat area; distinct white transverse bands on the distal portion of all four limbs just above the dark hoof boundaries; white facial markings between the eyes.
